facts.business: Equitas Small Finance Bank Limited is a small finance bank providing retail, wholesale, treasury, and other banking services in India.
facts.related_party_note: Related party transactions include CSR contributions to Equitas Development Initiatives Trust (Rs 11.50 crore) and Equitas Healthcare Foundation (Rs 3.17 crore), rent and electricity for ATM at hospital premises (Rs 0.01 crore), safe deposit locker rent, term deposits received and closed, and interest on term and savings deposits with related parties.
